scripts.build: pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-telemetry run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-schema run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-tui run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-codemode run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-mcp run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-ai run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-agent-core run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent run build
scripts.build:offline: pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-telemetry run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-schema run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-tui run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-codemode run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-mcp run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-ai run build:offline && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-agent-core run build && pnpm --filter @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent run build

scripts.version:major: pnpm version major -r && node scripts/sync-versions.js && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
